newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed slightly lower after posting gains in early trade on Wednesday amid profit-taking in leading blue chips, dealers said.
"Heavy institutional selling prompted retail investors to book profits near the close," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 1.14 points, or 0.07 percent, to close at 1,742.39 with 192 gainers and 151 losers.
PTCL fell 0.70 rupees to 30.80 rupees but ICI Pakistan gained 0.50 to 28.20. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
